Step 1: Harry is white. (Fact)

Step 2: From Rule “If someone is white then they are kind” licensed by Fact 1, we infer: Harry is kind. (Rule: White→Kind)

Step 3: From Rule “If Harry is kind then Harry is cold” licensed by Step 2, we infer: Harry is cold. (Rule: HarryKind→Cold)

Step 4: From Rule “All cold people are red” licensed by Step 3, we infer: Harry is red. (Rule: Cold→Red)

The statement “Harry is red” follows.

ANSWER: True

Facts: "Harry is white." Rule: If someone is white then they are kind. So we derive: Harry is kind. Rule: If Harry is kind then Harry is cold. So derive: Harry is cold. Rule: All cold people are red. So derive: Harry is red. So statement follows. So answer True.
